# FLX-3511: a catalogue configuration file sits in the current directory

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The Iceberg sink loads its catalogue through pyiceberg, which reads its configuration from a .pyiceberg.yaml file in PYICEBERG_HOME, in the home directory and in the current directory, and a catalogue's configuration can name the endpoint that receives the storage requests the sink signs with the person's own credentials. So the sink refuses to start when a .pyiceberg.yaml file is in the current directory and the current directory is neither the home directory nor PYICEBERG_HOME: a bundle directory cannot point a catalogue at another endpoint by carrying such a file. Run the command from another directory, or keep the catalogue configuration in the home directory or in the directory PYICEBERG_HOME names. Nothing was written.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3511
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
